verdict.rationale: Only the Rive runtimes and renderer are documented as open source. The evidence never shows the editor or design platform being self-hostable or openly licensed, and community comments say the open-source part is only the rendering layer, which still requires the paid Rive Editor to build content. Open-source runtime libraries are an adjacent component, not the self-hosted full platform the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full design platform on my own infrastructure under an open-source license
